literal: Hostility against, having yielded to conduct themselves those who are capable, who indeed, to conquer desiring nature they?
translation: Who indeed possesses the power to conquer those who are capable of yielding and conducting themselves peacefully when confronted with hostility?
modern: பகைமைக்கு எதிராகப் பணிந்து நடக்க வல்லவர்களை வெல்ல நினைக்கும் தன்மையுடையவர் யார் இருக்கிறார்கள்? (யாரும் இல்லை).
explanation: The couplet highlights the power of humility and adaptability in the face of enmity. When confronted with hostility, those who have the wisdom and strength to yield or bend rather than react with anger become invincible. The author rhetorically asks who could possibly have the capacity or nature to conquer such people. By refusing to engage in conflict and instead choosing a path of peaceful accommodation, they disarm their opponents completely, making themselves unconquerable.
